material.private_lifetime: 0600 task directory; never retained as public evidence; exact account materials used only through formal browser login.
material.expected: Per-mode exact synthetic IDs/versions/counts from formal same-root preparation; immutable artifact schema fixed before implementation. No raw credential value, key, cookie/CSRF or SQL in expected.
material.system: null except navigation; minimal existing formal Selection/Summary draft fixtures for aggregate guard only, no invocation or summary generation.

ipc.sequence: strict next integer 1..128 per case; never reuse ack; one controller receiver, one outstanding request, duplicate/gap/unknown/oversize fail case
ipc.publication: 0600 temp+atomic rename under exact task directory; no symlink/traversal; full JSON+EOF, exact members; fixed error enum only and result/error exclusive
ipc.unknown_control: never dispatch SQL/HTTP or fake an ok; store safe failure flag, cancel owned work and fail after real retirement

counts.result: exact nonnegative safe counts by source/family/method, mutations vs POST lookups, Session checks, armed/claimed/upstream-complete/browser-EOF/handler-joined, schema/client bodies; no raw request data

arm.args: {operation: one of17 typed endpoint names OR getCurrentSession, project: fixed mode project key except Session, target_id: known registered ID only when endpoint has target, query: exact read query only, effect: closed allowed effect}
arm.guard: one arm at a time; exact registered Project/target class/method/canonical path+query, next single matching browser request only; unmatched/passive requests unchanged; cannot arm arbitrary URL, HTTP headers or global path
arm.effect_scope: before_dispatch_hold reads/Session only; after_complete_cut/disconnect only nine mutation endpoints and exact admitted safe final receipt; after_complete_hold reads or mutation. Session body never persisted.

control-state.guard: request_token assigned by one actual registered outer handler; state is observation, not body/commit proof

release.guard: both exact identifiers required; release cannot assert joined or release another current request; no null/wildcard release

snapshot.result: safe ID/version/deleted facts, committed per-family command/audit counts and ref presence; compare booleans and byte lengths only
snapshot.guard: same root Store, bounded read Tx; no raw request/key/material/digest/cookie/CSRF/SQL. Current state and receipt history are separate facts.

logout.guard: formal Account Logout for exact registered same-root browser Session. No cookie/CSRF/material in ack/evidence; not direct revoked_at SQL.

archive-recovery-project.guard: one-way active→archived exact pre-owned initialized row and version; no pending→initialized, no lifecycle participants. Register cleanup, label auxiliary SQL fact, never claim real archive workflow.

reference-fact.guard: only preallocated isolated reference slot and seeded Model with exact accepted scope/owner/role/target predicates; no caller SQL/ID replacement or production adapter. Actual delete still must return DEPENDENCY_UNBOUND when present.

rename-reuse.guard: formal Project update plus existing accepted private creation fixture for one fixed preallocated name pair; no lifecycle/runtime acceptance, same original ID vs new ID asserted.

private_replay_comparison.keys: assigned safe origin token, exact Project/endpoint/method and current request token; idempotency key and complete first body retained only in bounded private memory
private_replay_comparison.result: body_equal,key_equal,target_equal,identity_equal,method_equal plus byte lengths and committed count; never values, raw bytes or request/material/key digests
private_replay_comparison.semantics: lookup excludes material and carries original kind/key only as contract; historical observation never marked original Execute confirmation; no current GET required before replay

proxy_join: register servers, each handler, observer, control loop, Node/schema children, prep Store/root and cleanup before start; held joined only at actual outer-handler return/unwind after ReverseProxy body/write/ErrorHandler. Release/body-close/EOF alone cannot join. Apply the accepted D1 boundary; do not reopen stopped join repairs.

evidence.filenames: response-{sequence:03}.json and body-{sha256}.json0600 only after safe response admission
evidence.body_stage: complete_formal_upstream; not browser EOF or commit proof
evidence.admission: Only own fixed Project17 endpoints safe typed responses/Problems; synthetic configuration values allowlisted. Unknown shape/echo/private material is failed in memory, never written. Auth/Session/material request bodies excluded. Response metadata/Mutation/receipt safe body is allowed, raw Credential value is not.
evidence.browser_correlation: exact request-token correlation observed privately plus method/path/query/status/content-type/length/request-id and full browser bytes/EOF; upstream-full, browser-complete, controlled-tail and durable Tx are separate sets
evidence.schema: same original safe admitted response bytes, actual operation/status and two formal Project models/credentials schemas with exact local common/security references; fixed Python/jsonschema import bundle; no network resolver
evidence.client: same retained original response bytes passed through actual browser-native new public17 APIs with exact request/response adapter; production request still actual root; replay parser request side effects disabled; no remarshal sample or fabricated DTO
evidence.screenshots: navigation exactly8: light/dark ×1440x900/390x844 ×normal/reduced; capture only after material input cleared and safe modal closed; actual image review needed

final_result.checks: exact true keys from checks_by_mode; never publish completed before every required check + body validator succeeds
final_result.counts: actual source-labelled attempts/completions/mutations/lookup/native EOF/upstream-full; no fixed equality across dispatch and sidecars. Every group requires actual relevant browser observations and safe schema/client success.
final_result.termination: on failure retain evidence already produced; missing finish/schema/client/DOM remain unobserved, not reconstructed as pass
